content: Sɑkɑri u mɑɑ nɔni seeyɑ mɑ u tɑbu kɛkɛ nnɛ wɑ yi dumi ɡɑwe yi yɑriɔ ɡuunu yirun bɑɑn di. Guu ni, nu sɑ̃ɑwɑ sii ɡɑnduɡinu.
Tɑbu kɛkɛ ɡbiikɑɑ, dum swɛ̃ɛyɑ yi ɡɑwe. Yiruse, kɔnkɔrɔbɑ.
Itɑse, kɑɑbɑ. Nnɛse, dumi yi yi bɑu swɑ̃ɑsu mɔ.
Mɑ u ɡɔrɑdo wi u kɑ nùn ɡɑri mɔ̀ bikiɑ u nɛɛ, berɑ̀ mi nɛn Yinni.
U nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, wɔllun ɡoonu nnɛn wosɑ si su rɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ Gusunɔ, tem kpuron Yinnin bɔkuɔ. Siyɑ su tɛ̃ doonɔ.
Dum kɔnkɔrɔ be bɑ tɑbu kɛkɛ yen tiɑ ɡɑwe mi, bɑ dɔɔwɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm ɡeu ɡiɑ. Mɑ dum kɑɑ be, bɑ swĩi. Adɑmɑ dum bɑu swɑ̃ɑsuɡii yi, yi dɔɔwɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm dwɑru ɡiɑ.
Dum swɛ̃ɛ yi, yi yɑrɑ mɑ yi kɑnɑ yi dɑ yi tem bukiɑnɑ. Mɑ ɡɔrɑdo wi, u yi sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, yi doo yi tem mɛ bukiɑnɑ. Mɑ yi tem mɛ bukiɑnɑ.
Gɔrɑdo wi, u nùn sokɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ mɛɛrio ɑ wɑ. Dumi yi yi dɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm ɡeu ɡiɑ mi, yi Gusunɔn mɔru suresiɑwɑ berɑ mi.
Yinni Gusunɔ u Sɑkɑri sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ,
ɑ yoo beni, Hɛlidɑi kɑ Tobiyɑ kɑ Yedɑyɑn kɛ̃nu mɔɔ kpɑ ɑ dɑ Yosiɑsi, Sofonin biin yɛnuɔ mi yoo be, bɑ wɑ̃ɑ sɑnɑm mɛ bɑ tunumɑ Bɑbiloniɔ.
Kpɑ ɑ sii ɡeesu kɑ wurɑ suɑ ɑ kɑ sinɑ furɔ ko ɡe kɑɑ doke Yosue, yɑ̃ku kowo tɔnwero, Yosɑdɑkin biin wirɔ.
Kpɑ ɑ nùn sɔ̃ ɑ nɛɛ, ɑmɛniwɑ nɛ, Gusunɔ wɔllu kɑ tem Yinni nɑ ɡeruɑ. Nɑ nɛɛ,

content.text: ɡoo wɑ̃ɑ wi bɑ mɔ̀ kpii pɔturɑ.
Sɑɑ win min diyɑ wɑ̃ɑrɑ koo yɑri
kpɑ u nɛn sɑ̃ɑ yee te bɑni.
kpɑ u sinɑ win sinɑ ɡɔnɑɔ u tɔmbu kpɑrɑ.
Yɑ̃ku kowo ko n wɑ̃ɑ win bɔkuɔ
kpɑ bɑ n nɔɔ tiɑ sɑ̃ɑ mɑm mɑm.

content: Sinɑ furɔ ɡe, ɡɑ ko n wɑ̃ɑwɑ nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ. Geyɑ ɡɑ koo de bu Helɛmu kɑ Tobiyɑ kɑ Yedɑyɑ kɑ Hɛni, Sofonin bii yɑɑyɑ.

Mɑ Sɑkɑri u nɛɛ, be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ n tomɑ, bɑ koo nɑ bu sɑ̃ɑ yee te bɑni. Sɑɑ ye sɔɔrɑ bɑ koo ɡiɑ mɑ nɛ, Gusunɔ wɔllu kɑ tem Yinniwɑ nɑ nun ɡɔrimɑ. Yeni kpuro yɑ koo koorɑwɑ ì n nɛ, Gusunɔ bɛɛn Yinnin ɡere mɛm nɔɔwɑ mɑm mɑm.
